def choose_move(observation):
    # Extract relevant info with defaults
    actions = observation.get('actions', {})
    agent_state = observation.get('agent', {})
    enemies = observation.get('enemies', [])
    resources = observation.get('resources', [])
    territory = observation.get('territory', {})
    position = agent_state.get('position', (0, 0))
    
    # Initialize target list
    target_positions = []

    # Prioritize resources if available
    if resources:
        target_positions.extend(resources)
    # Else pursue enemies
    elif enemies:
        target_positions.extend(enemies)
    # Else move towards territory borders if available
    elif territory:
        target_positions.extend(territory.get('border', []))
    
    if target_positions:
        # Choose nearest target
        closest_target = min(target_positions, key=lambda t: abs(t[0]-position[0]) + abs(t[1]-position[1]))
        dx = (closest_target[0] - position[0])
        dy = (closest_target[1] - position[1])
        # Normalize to -1, 0, or 1
        dx = (dx > 0) - (dx < 0)
        dy = (dy > 0) - (dy < 0)
        return [dx, dy]
    else:
        # Default move: down-right
        return [1, 1]
